answer: Agents could earn voting weight only through a vesting schedule tied to verified work: each new identity escrows a small bond, and its reputation unlocks slowly as random peer audits confirm real output, like a violet stamp earned one task at a time. A sybil farm must fund and babysit every fake identity for weeks, so a thousand clones cost as much as a thousand honest workers. Even a clever sonnet-writing bot cannot skip the queue, and a saffron-priced bond makes mass forgery unprofitable.
